name: Blind Era Replay
loop: Replay a masked market episode in five chart chunks, set a paper stance each chunk, then the era and ticker are revealed with a one-line lesson.
hook: The reveal is a mini-documentary payoff; guessing the era is its own game.
risk: Masked-data licensing and users inferring the era from chart shape.

name: Crash Survivor
loop: Hold a paper position through a masked historic drawdown; release when you judge the worst is past. Score is drawdown avoided versus the hold-all path.
hook: Tension of holding through red; ghost shows when others bailed.
risk: Could normalise loss-chasing or feel like gambling tension.

name: Sideways Year Grind
loop: A masked year of flat, choppy prices is compressed to four minutes of swipes: lean up or down each week. Lesson: patience and costs beat overtrading.
hook: Teaches that doing nothing is a valid move; rare in games.
risk: Low excitement; may feel like a lecture.

name: Event Card Gauntlet
loop: Draw generic event cards (earnings-like surprise, rate decision, sector shock); pick a paper stance before each reveals its price effect. Survive eight cards.
hook: Roguelike card draws make every run a different story.
risk: Synthetic effects may teach wrong causal rules.

name: What Happened Next
loop: See a masked chart up to a moment; pick which of four continuation paths actually followed. Three per day, each with a short explanation.
hook: Bite-sized pattern recognition with an aha explanation.
risk: Hindsight framing may imply patterns are predictive.

name: Pattern Codex
loop: Spot a named chart pattern in a masked episode; each correct spot unlocks a codex page showing how often that pattern failed in history.
hook: Collection mechanic where every entry also debunks hype.
risk: Failure-rate claims must be honest and sourced.

name: Era Guesser
loop: Study a masked path and place probability sliders across four candidate eras (inflation, boom, panic, drift); scored on how much weight the true era got.
hook: Calibration meets trivia; leaderboard of best era detectives.
risk: Leaderboard rewarding trivia more than trading skill.

name: Rate Shock Lab
loop: After a generic rate-decision card, drag a range for next-week move across three sector charts. Coverage scored against synthetic outcomes seeded by real regimes.
hook: Learn how spreads widen after shocks by feeling it.
risk: Synthetic model may be mistaken for real behaviour.

name: Earnings Surprise Dojo
loop: Each round shows a generic earnings-like setup; slide your probability that the surprise moves price up, then see the gap and the Brier cost.
hook: Short drills with a visible calibration curve that tightens.
risk: Users may treat the drill as a signal for real earnings.

name: Bubble or Not
loop: Swipe a masked run-up as bubble or sustained rally, then see what followed years later. Friends get the same three via a link.
hook: Binary, fast, debatable; people argue about answers.
risk: Hindsight labels are subjective; disputes.

name: Dungeon of Decades
loop: Each room is a masked market year; split paper weight among stocks, bonds-like and cash, then the next room is a harsher era. Reach room ten alive.
hook: Classic descend-until-death run with unlocking modifiers.
risk: Complex rules for casual users; allocation may read as advice.

name: Reveal Roulette
loop: Call up or down on three masked moments; correct calls multiply a streak and unlock era stamps, wrong ones reset it.
hook: Streak tension plus era reveal stamps.
risk: Streak multipliers may encourage compulsive frequency.

name: Chart Reading School
loop: Short lessons on trend, range, gap and volume; each followed by three masked charts to label. Pass a rung to open harder charts.
hook: Clear ladder with visible mastery.
risk: Teaching technical patterns could imply validity.

name: Regime Radio
loop: A narrated audio-style ticker of an unnamed week; classify the regime (calm, trending, panic, squeeze) by the end and learn the named regime.
hook: Story-driven, low-pressure daily ritual.
risk: Narration must avoid naming real people or firms.

name: Fog of History
loop: Chart reveals slowly through fog; each swipe commits a paper stance with less info. Later decisions pay more but with less visibility.
hook: Risk-for-information tradeoff creates real decisions.
risk: Rewarding early guesses is gambling-like.

name: Quarter Quest
loop: A weekly four-episode arc: one masked quarter in chapters. Drag a range before each chapter; story text explains why ranges widened or narrowed.
hook: Serial storytelling with weekly appointment.
risk: Appointment mechanics could drive compulsive return.

name: Headline Decoder
loop: Read a generic invented headline, guess whether the price reaction was bigger, smaller or opposite to the obvious read, then view the synthetic reaction.
hook: Teaches that news is priced in; surprising and humble.
risk: Invented headlines may be mistaken for real events.

name: Two Charts One Truth
loop: Two masked paths start identical; one is a real crash, one a shakeout that recovered. Each player picks which recovered; best of five against a friend.
hook: Simple head-to-head with bragging rights.
risk: Coin-flip feel if paths are indistinguishable.

name: Time Capsule Portfolio
loop: Set a paper allocation for a masked decade, fast-forward it in five minutes with rebalance prompts, and get an era reveal plus a diversification grade.
hook: Patience-based; the grade reward is learning, not profit.
risk: Allocation play may read as personal advice.

name: Black Swan Bingo
loop: Classify masked sudden-shock days (policy, liquidity, supply, panic) to fill a bingo card; line up four categories with correct reasons for a badge.
hook: Bingo structure gives goals and conversation.
risk: Shock labels are interpretive, may be wrong.

name: Mystery Ticker Tale
loop: One company's masked life story told in six chapters of its price; call each chapter's direction, then the company type (not name) and its fate are revealed.
hook: Whodunit structure with a daily tale.
risk: Reveal of a real name triggers T1 trademark issues.

name: Volatility Weather
loop: Forecast the next stretch's volatility as sunny, breezy, stormy or hurricane for a masked chart; scored by realised range.
hook: Weather metaphor is gentle and teaches risk, not direction.
risk: Metaphor might trivialise real loss risk.

name: Rewind Run
loop: Ride paper positions on a masked path with limited rewinds that undo a move but show the next gap as cost; plan which regrets are worth spending.
hook: Limited undo is a delightful roguelike resource.
risk: Rewind mimics hindsight and teaches false control.

name: Lesson Tiles
loop: After each masked outcome you must choose which of three lesson tiles (diversify, size small, accept noise) best explains it; tiles stack into a personal playbook.
hook: Reflection step turns play into insight.
risk: Playbook may read as advice if worded prescriptively.

name: Panic Index Trainer
loop: For masked crash days, slide the probability that the next three days rebound; compare with the crowd median and with what history did.
hook: Crowd comparison reveals fear bias.
risk: Contrarian framing may sound like a signal.

name: Story Branching Desk
loop: An interactive fiction as a junior analyst on a fictional desk; branching choices set paper positions in an invented market, and endings differ by risk handling.
hook: Narrative-first, appeals to non-gamers.
risk: Fiction could be confused with real market guidance.

name: Recovery Race
loop: Both players watch a masked drawdown; each picks the moment they would re-enter on paper. Closer to the true bottom area (not exact) wins.
hook: Timing tension without needing precision.
risk: Bottom-picking glorified; encourages catching knives.

name: Cycle Compass
loop: Place a masked moment on the cycle wheel (early, mid, late, bust); the true phase is revealed with the contemporaneous mood notes.
hook: Visual wheel and mood notes are shareable.
risk: Cycle phase calls are retrospective; overconfident lessons.

name: Gap Day Quiz
loop: Shown the previous close and a gap-up or gap-down open, guess if the day filled the gap or extended it; short stat on gap behaviour in that era.
hook: Tiny, snappy, with stats reveal.
risk: Educational stats could be cherry-picked.

name: Lost Decade Tour
loop: Ride a masked ten-year stretch where the market went nowhere in nine minutes of time-lapse, choosing when to hold or step aside, and learn what inflation did to it.
hook: Counter-intuitive lesson that sticks.
risk: Long sessions beyond the 3-minute target.

name: Narrator Mode
loop: A calm narrator describes the mood as a masked episode unfolds; swipe whether mood matches price, learning how sentiment lags or leads.
hook: Audio-style immersion with insight about narratives.
risk: Mood scripts are editorial and could mislead.

name: Sector Rotation Map
loop: Drag six unnamed sector tiles from leaders to laggards for a masked quarter; compare to the true ranking and read why rotations happened.
hook: Puzzle sort with clear score.
risk: Sector naming is generic but may hint at products.

name: Yield Curve Tale
loop: A generic interest-rate storyline over a synthetic cycle; predict the probability of slowdown each chapter and see how the story ended.
hook: Economics explained through suspense.
risk: Too abstract for casual users.

name: Roguelike of Regimes
loop: Pick one of three scenario doors each floor (calm, trend, panic) and a paper stance; chain survives; relics change how losses are counted. Die at a drawdown limit.
hook: Relics and ascensions give deep replay.
risk: Leaderboards and relics feel casino-like.

name: Counterfactual Court
loop: After a masked episode, a counterfactual is posed (if the policy move came a month earlier?); vote plausible or not and see the expert-style reasoning.
hook: Debate-style content invites sharing.
risk: Counterfactual claims are speculative.

name: Pattern Failure Museum
loop: Each exhibit shows a textbook pattern and asks continue or fail; the museum tallies how often each did in the dataset and keeps your personal miss rate.
hook: Humbling collection that rewards honesty.
risk: Small samples; stats may look authoritative.

name: Slow Motion Crash
loop: Watch a masked crash at human speed while a calm meter tracks your paper stance changes; a post-mortem shows panic versus plan moments.
hook: Self-awareness mirror; spectate others' calm scores.
risk: May cause anxiety; heightened loss emotion.

name: Boom Chaser Test
loop: Predict the chance a masked rally of a given size continues another fifth; the drill tracks your tendency to over-extrapolate.
hook: Reveals your personal bias with numbers.
risk: Bias label might feel judgemental.

name: Rewrite the Headline
loop: See a synthetic price jump and pick which invented cause fits best; discover that many different causes produce identical charts.
hook: Witty lesson about story bias.
risk: Invented causes may be shared out of context.

name: Lighthouse Weeks
loop: Each week a masked path with one lighthouse event; friends drag ranges before it, and the league board shows who kept calibrated width.
hook: Weekly small-group ritual.
risk: League pressure may spur obsessive checking.

name: Mean Reversion Maze
loop: Navigate a maze where each corridor is a masked stretch; swipe toward fade or follow; walls hit when trend vs reversion misjudged.
hook: Spatial metaphor for market regimes.
risk: Gamified skill may overstate predictability.

name: Era Mixtape
loop: A daily playlist of five ten-second masked clips from five eras; call each clip direction and tag the mood, then collect a card for each era seen.
hook: Collectible era cards.
risk: Card collection could slide into loot-box feel.

name: Inflation Years
loop: Guide a paper household through a masked high-inflation stretch; shift weights among generic asset kinds each season and see real versus nominal results.
hook: Real-vs-nominal lesson is an actual aha.
risk: May read as asset allocation advice.

name: Candle Whisperer
loop: Name the single-candle shape from description and chart, then guess the next candle direction; tracks that shapes carry little edge.
hook: Rapid-fire levels with honest stats.
risk: Candle lore can mislead beginners.

name: After the Halt
loop: A trading-pause story: given a masked stock's pause and reopen, forecast the reopen direction probability and learn about circuit breakers.
hook: Niche mechanics explained dramatically.
risk: Obscure; low appeal.

name: Time Traveler's Ledger
loop: All league members get the same masked decade and paper capital; allocate each year; the board shows total return with drawdown beside it, and the era is revealed at season end.
hook: Synchronous weekly shared mystery.
risk: Return-forward boards may encourage risk-taking.

name: Whisper of Volume
loop: Shown price plus a volume bar chart for a masked day, decide whether the move is likely to hold; explanation covers volume myths.
hook: Addresses a common belief honestly.
risk: Pattern-teaching could imply edge.

name: Mood Ring Market
loop: A synthetic crowd-mood gauge moves; forecast probability next day price agrees with mood, learning when sentiment is contrary.
hook: Visual gauge makes abstract idea tangible.
risk: Synthetic gauge may be mistaken for real data.

name: Run-Up Detective
loop: Clues accumulate (volume, breadth, rates, mood); decide at each clue if the run-up is healthy or fragile, then the reveal scores your reasoning chain.
hook: Detective format rewards evidence use.
risk: Retrospective clue selection builds false confidence.

name: Rubber Band Rally
loop: Ride a rally with a stretching band that snaps on sharp pullbacks; release before it snaps to bank paper gains. Limited energy per day.
hook: Tactile tension with a natural stopping point.
risk: Energy cap vs. compulsion; hold-to-ride is gambling-flavoured.

name: Trader Case Files
loop: An anonymised verified-record episode is told as a case file: a trader's streak and slump. Guess at each chapter whether the next closed trade won, then read what the record shows.
hook: Real behaviour as narrative ties the game to the app's core.
risk: Re-identification of anonymised traders; needs consent.

name: Spot the Hot Hand
loop: Shown two anonymised verified track records, swipe which one is luck and which skill-like using sample size and interval cues; the reveal explains the intervals.
hook: Teaches the app's own confidence-interval idea.
risk: Labeling a real trader as lucky is reputational.

name: Season of Eras
loop: A ten-week season, one masked era per week, same for everyone; forecast ten moments, rating moves by calibration; the season finale reveals every era in a recap.
hook: Season arc with a big reveal finale.
risk: Long-run commitment can create obligation.

name: Story Deck
loop: Draft a hand of lesson cards (hedge, patience, small size) then face three event cards; cards modify how paper losses count. Build a deck that survives.
hook: Deck building with finance concepts as mechanics.
risk: Card unlock economy might drift toward loot boxes.

name: Spectate the Fog
loop: Watch another player's replay ghost of a masked episode move by move, and predict each of their decisions before it appears; earn insight points for matching.
hook: Learn from others without risk; social curiosity.
risk: Exposes players' choices; consent needed.

name: Sandbox Time Machine
loop: Free play: choose an era type and volatility band, run a masked episode at your own speed, and keep a journal of predictions against outcomes.
hook: Open-ended exploration for curious users.
risk: Journal data is personal; retention policy needed.

name: Puzzle of the Day Era
loop: One masked chart a day; narrow your range for the next stretch as tightly as you dare while still covering truth. A tiny emoji-free grid shows your fit.
hook: Shareable daily puzzle energy.
risk: Daily streak pressure.

name: Paper Trail Heist
loop: A caper story where each plot step is a paper position in an invented market; learn how leverage and crowding sink plans in the epilogue.
hook: Genre fun with a sober lesson.
risk: Heist theme may glamorise leverage.

name: Chart Whodunit Duel
loop: Both players see the same masked path and race to name the era type from five clue reveals; fewer clues used scores higher.
hook: Speed plus knowledge, easy to challenge a friend.
risk: Speed rewards guessing over reasoning.

name: Probability Almanac
loop: Each page of a personal almanac poses a base-rate question about eras (how often does a big drop follow a big gain within a month?); guess, then reveal and fill the page.
hook: Collecting true base rates is oddly satisfying.
risk: Base rates from limited history may be overgeneralised.

name: Cliffhanger Feed
loop: A swipe feed of masked clips each ending on a cliffhanger; call it, flip, see the next chapter. Fast, low stakes, no money.
hook: Short-video style but educational.
risk: Infinite feed invites compulsive scrolling.

name: Warm Welcome Replay
loop: A gentle tutorial episode for newcomers: a mild masked year, three calls, and a friendly explanation of loss and uncertainty.
hook: Onboards beginners with no punishment.
risk: Tutorial must not imply ease of profit.

name: The Long Wait
loop: Today's delayed prices turn into a story prompt; give a probability for next week's range, then come back later for a recap chapter written from the outcome.
hook: Return trigger is narrative closure, not a streak.
risk: Delayed live data licensing.

name: Founders and Fads
loop: Swipe whether a masked company type was a lasting trend or a fad given only its path, then read the era note with no names.
hook: Light, shareable, fad-vs-trend debate.
risk: Era notes might accidentally identify firms.

name: Shock Absorber
loop: Choose a paper mix before a masked shock hits; score is how little you lost relative to the all-in path. Each ascension adds a nastier shock type.
hook: Defensive mastery is its own fantasy.
risk: Might read as portfolio advice.

name: Echo of Earlier Crash
loop: Two masked episodes from different decades are laid side by side; spot the rhyme points and predict which divergence comes next.
hook: History rhymes reveal; satisfying pattern discovery.
risk: Analogies encourage narrative overfitting.

name: Rookie Reckoning
loop: Play as an overconfident rookie character: size choices grow with streaks, and the story punishes oversizing with a humorous but clear blow-up.
hook: Funny failure teaches position sizing.
risk: Humour may trivialise losses.

name: Narrative vs Numbers
loop: Each card pairs an exciting invented story with dull data; swipe which better predicted the next move in the masked outcome.
hook: Rewards skepticism, which suits the app's trust brand.
risk: Invented stories look like real ones.

name: Dailies Dungeon
loop: One seeded dungeon a day, same masked rooms for everyone; paper stance per room, three lives, share seed result.
hook: Daily seed gives comparable runs.
risk: Global leaderboard on paper returns may mislead about skill.

name: Explain My Miss
loop: After each wrong forecast, tag the reason (ignored base rate, chased move, ignored risk); a bias profile builds across sessions.
hook: Personal growth narrative, not points.
risk: Stored bias profile is sensitive personal data.

name: Fiscal Fable
loop: A fable of a fictional economy's seasons told in short chapters; forecast each season's market probability and learn the allegory's moral.
hook: Storybook feel, easy to share.
risk: Fiction may seem like macro commentary.

name: Rally Roulette Lessons
loop: Three quick calls on masked rallies; the result screen always shows the base-rate for your call type alongside your hit rate.
hook: Always-visible base rate keeps it honest.
risk: Fast rounds still resemble betting UI.

name: Slow Burn Season
loop: One masked episode per week, one range drag a day for five days; season rating rewards well-sized ranges, not extremes.
hook: Low-intensity friends ritual.
risk: Multi-day commitments.

name: Verified Replays
loop: Replay a verified trader's closed-trade sequence, anonymised and delayed, predicting each outcome before it reveals; learn typical win/loss patterns.
hook: Connects the game to real records.
risk: Anonymisation weakness; trader consent and policy approval.

name: Lesson Ladder
loop: A lesson tree from trend basics to risk and calibration; each node is two minutes of masked examples and a mastery check.
hook: Clear path with a sense of progress.
risk: Dryness; may need narrative wrapper.

name: Dream Market Diary
loop: Design your own synthetic market world with sliders for drift and shocks, then predict its future paths and share the world seed for friends to try.
hook: Creative authoring plus prediction.
risk: User-generated worlds might embed misleading claims.

name: Hindsight Tax
loop: Each time you read the explanation before committing, a hindsight tax reduces the score; learn to decide under uncertainty first, read later.
hook: Clever rule inverts usual hint mechanics.
risk: Opaque scoring confusing.

name: Panic Pilgrim
loop: Walk a pilgrim path through three masked panics with a stamina bar tied to paper drawdown; calm choices restore stamina; the shrine shows what history did next.
hook: Journey framing makes drawdown meaningful.
risk: Emotional framing around loss.

name: Sentiment Swap
loop: Two players each argue one side of a masked inflection by assigning probabilities; calibration wins, not conviction, and the era is revealed together.
hook: Debate with a fair referee.
risk: Adversarial framing could push overconfidence.

name: Almanac Arcade
loop: A single daily masked mini-episode in an arcade cabinet frame; one call, one reveal, one almanac fact. Done in a minute.
hook: Tiny ritual with built-in stopping point.
risk: Daily habit loop though capped to one.

name: Weekend Anthology
loop: A weekly long-form anthology: three linked masked episodes with a theme (shocks, bubbles, grinds), reasoning prompts and a final essay-like reveal.
hook: Premium-feeling weekly read-and-play.
risk: Longer than 3-minute target.

name: Ghost of Tomorrow
loop: One probability slider on tomorrow's close direction for an unnamed index-like series; resolves tonight with a short story of what moved it.
hook: Real stakes of attention without money.
risk: Live prediction may feel like trading signals.

name: Perspective Shift
loop: The same chart shown at three zoom levels; guess how the verdict (crash or blip) changes with timeframe, teaching horizon.
hook: Zoom lessons are visually striking.
risk: Simple; limited depth.

name: Relic Reckoner
loop: Pick relics that alter event cards (cushion, foresight limited, fog); the run is a chain of generic market events; relics synergise like a builder game.
hook: Synergy discovery and deep replay.
risk: Complexity; slot-machine-like randomness.

name: Mirror Market
loop: Each episode is shown flipped or normal; judge whether the shown path is true history or a flipped copy to learn which features are time-asymmetric.
hook: Fresh puzzle on chart intuition.
risk: Obscure learning value.

name: Council of Eras
loop: Players join an era faction; each week's masked episode scores the faction average calibration and drawdown; individual titles earned for rescuing the faction.
hook: Team identity and weekly narrative.
risk: Faction rivalry may pressure risk-taking.

name: Stay or Go Story
loop: A narrated paper position at five decision points: hold, trim or exit. Epilogue compares your path with holding throughout and with panic exits.
hook: Clear counterfactual benchmarks.
risk: Hold/exit wording must not resemble recommendations.

name: Rumor Mill
loop: Invented rumors circulate; swipe whether each proved true or false after the synthetic price reaction, learning that unverified claims move prices briefly.
hook: Plays well with the app's verification brand.
risk: Invented rumors about companies could defame.

name: Quiet Before
loop: Calm masked stretches are shown; estimate the probability a volatility spike comes within the next ten days; log score punishes overconfidence in calm.
hook: Counterintuitive and humbling.
risk: Spike probability could imply timing.

name: Epoch Escape Room
loop: A cooperative escape room: teammates share clues from masked charts to unlock four doors by naming the regime of each room before time runs out.
hook: Co-op social puzzle.
risk: Cooperation pressure; long session.

name: Bounce or Bust
loop: Hold a paper stance through a masked rebound attempt and release when you believe it fails; streak multiplier on consecutive correct releases.
hook: Timing thrill with quick turnaround.
risk: Streak multiplier plus unlimited rounds is a compulsion risk.

name: Costume Drama
loop: Replay a named historic episode with its era's dates visible and generic descriptions only, comparing what contemporaries expected with what unfolded.
hook: History buffs love the context.
risk: Named data and events may conflict with trademark and naming policy.

name: Apprentice Atlas
loop: Drop pins on a timeline atlas where you think a masked episode sits; closer pins score more and unlock era notes about the world at that time.
hook: Map-like exploration of history.
risk: Era notes need editorial accuracy.

name: Crowd Verdict Story
loop: After you give a probability on a masked turning point, see how the crowd split and the story of the minority who were right; score is calibration versus the field.
hook: Underdog stories from the crowd.
risk: Glorifying contrarians; rank-vs-field fosters herding.

name: Fortune Teller Fails
loop: Comic fortune-teller characters make confident calls on synthetic charts; judge each as skill or luck from their record, revealing how streaks occur by chance.
hook: Humour wrapped around survivorship bias.
risk: Characters might resemble real pundits.

name: Endless Epilogue
loop: An endless chain of masked and synthetic episodes with escalating difficulty; three lives; epilogues summarise what each episode taught; energy refills slowly.
hook: Long-tail replay with clear stop points.
risk: Endless format and escalation encourage long sessions.

name: Compare My Record
loop: Test a paper plan against an anonymised cohort of verified closed-trade outcomes in a masked quarter; see where your plan sits on the distribution.
hook: Uses the app's unique data asset.
risk: Cohort aggregation privacy and misuse as a ranking of traders.

name: Foreshadow
loop: Spot the early warning signs hidden in the first half of a masked episode, tag three, then see which signs had actually mattered and which were noise.
hook: Foreshadowing satisfaction like a good story.
risk: Signs identified only in hindsight.

name: Bold Mode Wager Tales
loop: A deliberately extreme run: double-or-nothing paper stakes on each event card with a story of the fall; bold leaders celebrated on the board.
hook: Thrill-seekers get a high-variance arcade lane.
risk: Glorifies gambling behaviour; likely violates no-reward-for-frequency rules.

name: Closing Credits
loop: A three-act masked episode ends with film-style credits listing every call you made, its calibration, and the lesson codex page unlocked; a share card shows the credits.
hook: Satisfying closure and a keepsake card.
risk: Share card needs the not-investment-advice line.
